raw_evidence.context: At King’s we aim to engage and work collaboratively in every region of the world. We do this through equitable partnerships with like-minded institutions, memberships in university networks and engagement with key regional and national stakeholders. Regional strategies guide our global engagement priorities by informing our regional networks and partnerships, our internal hubs for engagement, the sharing of best practices and horizon scanning. This commitment to international engagement provides enrichening educational and volunteering experiences for our students, fosters joint research that addresses global challenges and contributes to the prosperity of local and global communities. Contact us globalengagement@kcl.ac.uk
